Name: Mermaid Essence Potion Decor
Author: AbrahMods
Description:
🧜‍♀️ Mermaid Essence Potion (CP)[i]A decorative furniture mod by Abrah.[/i]
Bring the mystical beauty of the ocean right into your farmhouse!
This glowing potion shimmers like a mermaid’s tears, perfect for adding a dreamy, ethereal touch to your room.
[line]💫 Features[list]
[*]Adds a new decorative furniture item: Mermaid Essence Potion 🩵
[*]32×32 sprite size
[*]2×1 footprint — sits perfectly against the wall
[*]Can be placed anywhere as decor (non-table object)
[*]Free to purchase in the Vanilla Furniture Catalogue (Robin’s shop)
[/list][line]🛠️ Requirements[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*]SMAPI 4.0+
[*]Content Patcher (Pathoschild)
[/list][i](Optional but recommended:)[/i]
[list]
[*]Abrah Furniture Catalogue — for future updates, all Abrah decor will be collected here!
[/list][line]🪞 How to Get It[list=1]
[*]Download and install SMAPI and Content Patcher.

[*]Drop the [code]MermaidEssencePotion (CP)[/code] folder into your [code]Mods[/code] folder.

[*]Launch the game!

[*]Go to Robin’s Carpenter Shop and open the Furniture Catalogue.

[*]Scroll until you find the shimmering Mermaid Essence Potion — it’s free! 💖

[/list][line]💕Made by Abrah and Spanish translation by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Hayato2236/mods]Hayato2236 [/url] 🩷
Pixel art and config by hand — fits perfectly with vanilla Stardew furniture style.
Part of the [i]Abrah Decor Collection.[/i]
[i]
